faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-016?
faqs.answer: Yes. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-016: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.
